rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
# Alpine's configuration, as it is. What we do differently is changed here. cp "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/busyboxconfig" .config
# Unlike Alpine, we build with PAM and SELinux. sed -i \ -e 's@^# CONFIG_PAM is not set@CONFIG_PAM=y@' \ -e 's@^# CONFIG_SELINUX is not set@CONFIG_SELINUX=y@' \ -e "s@^CONFIG_CROSS_COMPILER_PREFIX=.*@CONFIG_CROSS_COMPILER_PREFIX=\"$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-\"@" \ .config
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "tools" ]; then # The path that busybox runs itself through. sed -i \ -e 's@^CONFIG_SYSROOT=.*@CONFIG_SYSROOT="/tools"@' \ -e 's@^CONFIG_BUSYBOX_EXEC_PATH=.*@CONFIG_BUSYBOX_EXEC_PATH="/tools/bin/busybox"@' \ .config else sed -i \ -e 's@^CONFIG_SYSROOT=.*@CONFIG_SYSROOT="/"@' \ .config fi
yes "" | make oldconfig
rules.build:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make V=1 SKIP_STRIP=y -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
# The only program that is installed setuid root. It runs busybox for a # fixed list of applets, see the busybox-suid package. if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" != "tools" ]; then "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-gcc" $CPPFLAGS $CFLAGS \ "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/bbsuid.c" -o bbsuid $LDFLAGS fi
# The helper that wget calls for https, see Alpine's patch for wget. "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-gcc" $CPPFLAGS $CFLAGS \ "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/ssl_client.c" -o ssl_client \ $LDFLAGS -lssl -lcrypto
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
PREFIX_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"
# The links to the applets are not installed here. The trigger of the # busybox package creates those that no other package provides. install -D -m 0755 busybox "$PREFIX_DIR/bin/busybox" install -D -m 0755 ssl_client "$PREFIX_DIR/bin/ssl_client"
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" != "tools" ]; then install -D -m 4111 bbsuid "$PREFIX_DIR/bin/bbsuid" fi ln -s busybox "$PREFIX_DIR/bin/sh"
install -D -m 0755 "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/uname" "$PREFIX_DIR/bin/uname"
install -D -m 0755 "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/default.script" \ "$PREFIX_DIR/share/udhcpc/default.script" install -D -m 0644 "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/udhcpc.conf" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/udhcpc/udhcpc.conf"
# ifupdown needs these to be there. for name in if-down.d if-post-down.d if-post-up.d if-pre-down.d \ if-pre-up.d if-up.d; do install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/network/$name" done
